These imaging hallmarks are typical of IDH‑wildtype glioblastoma and argue against an IDH‑mutant, lower‑grade astrocytoma which usually exhibits less necrosis, less edema and less aggressive crossing behavior. Age 58 further supports a wildtype phenotype.
